spec.studio_prompt: A minimalist counter stool crafted from solid oak in a warm medium finish (#603e23, #826341) measuring 45 cm wide, 45 cm deep, and 90 cm high. The stool features four slender, tapered cylindrical legs connected by low horizontal foot stretchers. The rear legs extend upward to hold a sculpted, gently curved solid oak lumbar backrest. The seat rests at a 65 cm height, featuring a tightly woven paper cord surface in natural ecru (#b7afa4, #9c8e7a) stretched seamlessly over the rectangular side rails.
